summary: Layer 2B maps the candidate chunk to ticker-level relationships across Energy chokepoints. The strongest underfollowed relationship in this chunk is PLPC to utility-specified transmission-line hardware, because the provided external context directly claims mandatory line-hardware exposure, specification stickiness, low coverage, and insider ownership. Hammond Power, Powell, Hubbell, Arcosa, AZZ, and Valmont map to the broader grid-electrification stack, but their survival into later layers depends on primary-source validation of segment mix, backlog, pricing, and customer evidence. QPEEL maps to an India-listed HVDC/FACTS/power-quality niche, but the evidence is currently mostly secondary and needs IPO filing and customer-order verification. LEU maps to the nuclear fuel-cycle enrichment and HALEU bottleneck; evidence is thematically strong but execution, policy-award conversion, and legacy Russian-enrichment exposure remain key falsification risks. This is research mapping only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
